name: Glass collab invite
oneLiner: a collaboration invite on glass: the real face and the partner's initials sit apart with a dotted link and a plus between them; a finger presses Accept, Decline folds away as Accept drains to green, the two faces slide together and touch, a green outline draws round the pair, a check badge lands on the seam and the line turns over to the joined line
say: when the speaker says they teamed up with someone ('so we decided to collab', 'she invited me and I said yes'): cut in on the invite, Accept is pressed on the yes and the faces join as they say who. Set partner to the real name
